create_deterministic_hadamard_matrix: create a deterministic Hadamard matrix of a given power-of-two size using Sylvester construction
create_random_hadamard_matrix: create a randomly signed Hadamard matrix supporting non-power-of-two sizes from precomputed safetensors
test_is_pow2: test whether an integer is a positive power of two using a bitwise check
review_deterministic_hadamard_matrix: review the deterministic_hadamard_matrix function that constructs Sylvester Hadamard matrices with configurable dtype and device
review_random_hadamard_matrix: review the random_hadamard_matrix function that composes precomputed base matrices with random sign diagonals
